players.product: HDI (build-up) and multilayer printed circuit boards, including boards for AI servers

quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025), record first-half net sales JPY 111,493 million (up 13.6%, up JPY 13,335 million); operating profit JPY 11,418 million (up 22.9%), ordinary profit JPY 11,360 million (up 41.9%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 9,395 million (up 48.3%). Management states the electronic-components industry recovered moderately on expanding AI-server demand, strong sales of new game consoles, easing concern over large US tariff increases and a weak yen; automotive and smartphone / tablet boards turned to recovery, information-communication and amusement / digital-appliance / industrial boards stayed strong and the electronics (EMS) business grew sharply; orders were strong, factory utilisation rose mainly in Vietnam and sales of high-margin build-up boards increased sharply. H1 R&D expenses JPY 3,644 million.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 111,493 million (+13.6%); operating profit JPY 11,418 million (+22.9%); R&D JPY 3,644 million
